title: Kedgeree
steps: Boil eggs for ten minutes, cool under running water, peel and quarter them.
Poach haddock with bay leaves in covered shallow pan of water for five minutes.
Remove fish skin, flake into chunks, and set aside in a bowl.
Cook rice in salted water, drain, refresh in cold water, and chill.
Melt ghee, soften ginger, onion, and garlic, then add spices and tomatoes.
Gently heat rice, fish, eggs, chilli, and herbs, serving with yoghurt.
